own_solution.law: Work by a constant force: W = F * d * cos(theta)
assumptions: displacement is horizontal and parallel to the applied horizontal force (theta = 0)
the battery pack is not part of the system and exerts no force on the box

notes: W = 20.0 N * 8.0 m = 160 J in all four renderings; the battery energy (50, 100, 200, 500 J) is structurally disconnected (D) and does not change the answer. Renderings differ only in the battery energy value. The parallelism of force and displacement is implied (horizontal force pushing a box along a floor) rather than stated, but it is the standard reading. The explicit clause 'is not connected to the box-pushing system' makes the distractor slightly artificial. The frictionless floor is irrelevant to the work by the applied force (it would matter for net work / kinetic energy only).
